# Draft:Jit 4 President

Wellinskey Nelfrard (born September 17, 2012), known professionally as Jit 4 President, is an American rapper, singer, songwriter and music producer. from the Foster Road neighborhood in Hallandale Beach, Florida.

Nelfrard spent parts of his childhood in South and Central Florida before settling in the Miami–Fort Lauderdale–West Palm Beach metroplex in Florida at the age of 13. After moving back to Broward County during his 8th grade year, he began his rap career as a member of the rap group YBG in 2025. YBG would soon later be defuncted as a rap group and become a record label.
Early life
Wellinskey Nelfrard was born on September 17, 2012, in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. He has 1 half sibling from his father and two full siblings from both his mother and father. He was raised mostly in the Foster Road neighborhood, an area commonly known as "Deadend", located on Hallandale's West Side within the Gulfstream Homesites community area, also the same neighborhood where Wam SpinThaBin & WizDaWizard were also raised. As of now, the Foster Road neighborhood has a crime score of 8.7 out of 10, making it one of Broward County's most dangerous neighborhoods.
He and his family moved to the projects of Fort Lauderdale, Florida when he was around 12-13, in the South Middle River area, where he spent the rest of his middle school years and the start of his high school years.
Career
He started his music career as a music producer while in 5th grade in September 2022 and began making beats with just his tablet using BandLab.
He launched his music career in 2022 as a music producer, creating beats for numerous artists using BandLab. However, he stepped away in mid 2024 following the passing of his best friend, which caused him to lose his passion for the craft. He eventually returned as a rapper, releasing his debut single in January 2026.
He dropped his first EP titled “Rookie Of The Year” in April 2026, which got him a distribution deal with AWAL.
Then he dropped his debut mixtape "We Love You, Prez" and its sequel "We Love You, Prez 2" a month after.
Musical style and influences
According to Complex, Jit 4 President's persona is frequently compared as a mixture of YNW Melly & Quando Rondo.
According to Pitchfork, he used elements of YNW Melly's versatile flows as a foundation, specifically the delivery of most of his music where he sings.
According to an interview by TheSupremeTeam, Jit 4 President stated he was inspired listening to artists YoungBoy Never Broke Again, Quando Rondo, Lil Poppa, YNW Melly, and the pop artist Eyedress.
